scripts.build:cli: cargo build --release && mkdir -p dist/bin && cp target/release/ffc dist/bin/ffc
scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:site
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.test: cargo test && cargo build --bin ffc && npm run typecheck && npm run build:site && playwright test
